files.misc.verbalization.txt:
=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Task is identified by TaskId.
TaskId is a value of type Integer.
Score is a value of type Integer.
Stamp is a value of type Date.
Vehicle is identified by VehicleId.
VehicleId is a value of type Integer.
Plate is a value of type String.
Car is a kind of Vehicle, inheriting the reference of Vehicle.
Truck is a kind of Vehicle, inheriting the reference of Vehicle.
Gadget is identified by GadgetId.
GadgetId is a value of type Integer.
GLabel is a value of type String.
Widget is a kind of Gadget, inheriting the reference of Gadget.

=== Fact Types ===
Task scored from Score (low) to Score (high)
  - task: Task (Integer)
  - low: Score (Integer)
  - high: Score (Integer)

Task has points Score
  - task: Task (Integer)
  - points: Score (Integer)

Task logged on Stamp
  - task: Task (Integer)
  - at: Stamp (Date)

Task started on Stamp
  - task: Task (Integer)
  - on: Stamp (Date)

Task finished on Stamp
  - task: Task (Integer)
  - on: Stamp (Date)

Vehicle has plate Plate
  - vehicle: Vehicle (Integer)
  - plate: Plate (String)

Gadget has label GLabel
  - gadget: Gadget (Integer)
  - label: GLabel (String)
